# How many coils should each product get in my vending machine?

> Free vending machine planogram tool: enter your coils, each product's price, cost, weekly sales and units per coil, and get the coil split that earns the most, plus the best restocking gap. Nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
